findings.reason: MI001 remains AMBIGUOUS and OPEN, needed_at prepare. F0003:S1:T8:A94–A97 support this panel's strain, MIC, regimen and response-time associations. F0003:S1:T8:A98 explicitly states: "No matched measured PK for these efficacy regimens." This page therefore does not establish the complete panel–regimen–strain–MIC–exposure–response mapping required by DR020. Independent PD records remain available.
findings.needed_material: At prepare, verify and document supported associations and unresolved links using authorized evidence. A source-supported exposure input and its applicability to this efficacy regimen are needed before treating the panel as matched exposure-response records; do not join separate panels by assumption.

findings.reason: This page supplies K. pneumoniae FADDI-KP132, PMB MIC 8 mg/L, lung burden units, pre-treatment observations, vehicle observations at 24 h and a PMB dose schedule. It does not state host strain or immune status, inoculum, infection-to-treatment interval, explicit treatment duration, MIC method, medium, testing standard, replicates or summary definition. PK-to-PD compatibility cannot be established from this page.
findings.needed_material: Source-linked infection-model and susceptibility methods, explicit treatment timing and an applicability assessment for any separately sourced exposure inputs. Retain available observations while keeping these fields unresolved.

findings.reason: The page contains one PMB regimen, 90 mg/kg/day divided into three doses q8h, plus baseline and vehicle groups. It supplies no comparison across PMB dosing frequencies or intervals and no measured free-exposure indices. This page alone cannot establish design separation of fAUC/MIC, fCmax/MIC and fT>MIC.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported regimen variation and matched response, strain-MIC and free-exposure inputs for downstream index comparison. Keep ranking unresolved unless the complete authorized design supports separation.
